source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 3 (ISL A3) · lesson 20. Rewritten for children from Dr. Hassan's lesson; facts and references kept.
topic: The boy who chose the Prophet ﷺ

learn.en: As a boy, Zayd was captured and sold. He came to Khadījah, and she gave him to the Prophet ﷺ.
learn.title: Zayd's story

learn.en: Years later his father and uncle found him. The Prophet ﷺ let Zayd choose — and Zayd chose to stay with the Prophet ﷺ! Then the Prophet ﷺ freed him.
learn.title: Zayd's choice

learn.en: People called him “Zayd ibn Muhammad”, until Allah said: “Call them by their fathers.” (Qur'an 33:5; Bukhari 4782) So he was Zayd ibn Ḥārithah again.
learn.title: Call them by their fathers

learn.en: In Islam you may raise and love a child as your own, but the child keeps the name of his real father.
learn.title: Keeping the real name

learn.en: Zayd is the only Companion whose name is in the Qur'an. (Qur'an 33:37)
learn.title: Named in the Qur'an

quiz.en: Whom did Zayd choose to stay with?
What did people call Zayd before Qur'an 33:5 came?
True or false? Zayd's name is mentioned in the Qur'an.
True or false? An adopted child must take a new father's name.

think.q: Why do you think Zayd preferred to stay with the Prophet ﷺ?
think.a: Because of his kindness and character — he loved him more than anyone.

parents.summary: Zayd chose to stay with the Prophet ﷺ even when his family came for him. The Qur'an taught that every child keeps his real father's name. Zayd is the only Companion named in the Qur'an.
parents.tip: Talk about why our names and families matter.
